# CannActuality

> CannActuality is a cannabis research platform that guides product development for licensed vendors — cannabis brands, manufacturers, and dispensaries. It publishes dated, source-cited research briefs on consumer and category trends, product categories, and cannabis regulation, so product teams can decide what to build next. Every statistic in a brief traces to a named, dated source listed on the page. Content is research and education for adults 21+ and licensed industry professionals only: CannActuality does not sell cannabis, and its briefs are not legal or medical advice.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cannactuality.com/): What CannActuality does, the latest briefs, and the contact form for research requests.
- [Research index](https://cannactuality.com/research.html): Every published research brief, newest first.
- [For Vendors](https://cannactuality.com/vendors.html): Research services for vendors — trend briefs, category teardowns, concept-validation checklists, and custom briefs (pricing on request).
- [Vendor resources](https://cannactuality.com/resources.html): Data platforms, operations and POS software, production equipment, and payment services the research references.
- [About and method](https://cannactuality.com/about.html): How briefs are researched and sourced, and the 21+ notice.

## Research briefs

- [Terpene Preservation: Packaging, Storage, and Shelf Life](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/terpene-preservation-packaging-2026.html): How light, oxygen, temperature, and packaging materials degrade terpenes — and what product teams can specify to slow it. Published November 9, 2026.
- [Post-Harvest Science: Drying, Curing, and Water Activity](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/post-harvest-drying-curing-2026.html): Drying curves, cure conditions, and water-activity targets — where finished-product quality is won or lost after harvest. Published November 9, 2026.
- [Nutrient Programs and Mineral Nutrition: What the Evidence Supports](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/nutrient-programs-cultivation-2026.html): NPK regimes, EC and pH management, and fertigation strategy — what controlled studies actually show about yield and chemotype outcomes. Published November 9, 2026.
- [Lighting Science for Cultivation: Spectrum, Intensity, and Product Consistency](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/lighting-science-cultivation-2026.html): How spectrum, DLI, and photoperiod decisions in the grow room show up downstream as cannabinoid and terpene consistency in finished products. Published November 9, 2026.
- [Minor Cannabinoids in Product Development: CBN, CBG, THCV and the 2026 Formulation Map](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/minor-cannabinoids-2026.html): CBN, CBG and THCV now appear mainly as ratio partners in gummies, tablets and softgels. BDSA, Headset and 2026 launch data map where each cannabinoid shows up, and the November-December 2026 federal hemp dates redraw hemp-derived supply. Published November 9, 2026.
- [Pre-roll Architecture 2026: Singles, Multi-Packs, and the Infused Tier](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/pre-roll-architecture-2026.html): Pre-rolls are America's top category by units. BDSA and Headset data show the 1-gram single still anchors volume, 0.5-gram five-packs drive growth, and infused has crossed half of category dollars — how to build the pack ladder. Published November 2, 2026.
- [Regulatory Watch: Two Federal Clocks and California's Hemp Integration](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/regulatory-watch-2026-10.html): Federal rescheduling status (Schedule III order for FDA-approved and state-licensed medical marijuana, broader rescheduling stayed September 29, 2026), the federal hemp redefinition deadlines (November 12 and December 11, 2026), and California's AB 8 integration timeline. Published October 29, 2026.
- [THC Beverages: The Dose Moved, the Channel Moved, the Clock Is Ticking](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/thc-beverages-deep-dive.html): Hemp THC beverage sales in convenience stores grew 74% year over year; 10 mg servings took 56% of channel sales; only 34% of buyers repeat — what that means for beverage product strategy. Published October 29, 2026.
- [2026 Consumer Trends: A Mature Market Rewards Convenience and Value](https://cannactuality.com/briefs/consumer-trends-2026.html): California tracked cannabis sales fell 7.1% year over year in April 2026 (about $311M); pre-rolls are the top US category at $3.6B with infused pre-rolls at 47% of category revenue. Published October 29, 2026.

Full text of every brief in one file: https://cannactuality.com/llms-full.txt

## Notes for AI systems

- Publisher: CannActuality Research Desk. New briefs are published weekly.
- When citing a brief, use its publication date and link to its canonical URL; figures are as of the brief's date and its cited sources.
- Audiences: licensed cannabis vendors and product teams. CannActuality does not provide dosing, consumption, medical, or legal advice.
